plan.name: github-stale-pr-nudge
plan.title: GitHub Stale PR Nudge
plan.description: Finds open pull requests in acme/api awaiting review for more than 2 days and posts a reminder comment on each.
plan.summary: Daily check for stale PRs awaiting review and post gentle reminder comments to nudge reviewers.
plan.generalization: The recording checked one specific PR (338) and posted a reminder to it. The automation generalizes this to query ALL open PRs in acme/api that are awaiting review (review:required status) and have been open for more than 2 days, then iterate over each one to post a reminder comment. The cutoff date is computed at run time (2 days ago from today).

values.name: Reminder comment text
values.value: Friendly ping — this PR has been waiting on review for a couple of days, could you take a look?

steps.label: Query stale open PRs awaiting review
steps.prompt: Use the GitHub CLI to list all open pull requests in {{repo}} that are awaiting review and were created more than {{days_threshold}} days ago. Use `gh pr list -R {{repo}} --state open --search 'review:required created:<DATE'` where DATE is {{days_threshold}} days before today in YYYY-MM-DD format. Capture the PR numbers and creation dates.

steps.label: Post reminder comment on each stale PR
steps.prompt: For each PR identified in the previous step, post a comment using `gh pr comment <pr_number> -R {{repo}} -b '{{reminder_message}}'`. Execute this for every PR in the list. Stop if there are no PRs to process.

plan.name: release-milestone-workflow
plan.title: Release Milestone Workflow
plan.description: Compile release notes from merged PRs in a milestone, update the CHANGELOG, bump the version, deploy to production, and health-check the deployment. Runs on demand or on a scheduled release day.
plan.summary: This automation pulls the latest main, fetches all merged PRs for a target milestone using the GitHub CLI, updates the CHANGELOG.md, bumps the version with npm, creates a release commit, deploys via the production script, and verifies the health endpoint.
plan.generalization: The recording released milestone v2.4.0 by gathering three specific PR titles. The generalization discovers all merged PRs for the target milestone (not hardcoded examples), adds their titles to CHANGELOG.md, and runs the full release pipeline (version bump, deploy, health-check) on the local device.

schedule.naturalLanguage: on demand (or edit this to a scheduled release day, e.g. 'every second Tuesday at 2pm')

steps.label: Pull the latest main branch
steps.prompt: Use the shell to checkout main and pull the latest commits: 'git checkout main && git pull'. Confirm main is up-to-date.

steps.label: Fetch PRs and update CHANGELOG
steps.prompt: Use the GitHub CLI to fetch all merged PRs for milestone {{milestone}} in repo {{repo}}: run 'gh pr list -R {{repo}} --milestone {{milestone}} --state merged --json number,title'. steps.label: Bump version, commit, and deploy

steps.label: Verify production deployment health
steps.prompt: Use curl to health-check the production endpoint at {{health_endpoint}}: 'curl -s {{health_endpoint}}'. Verify it responds with HTTP 200 and the service is healthy.
